notes.title: A Step Into the Zone – With 45% Off and Quality of Life Update

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/41669/Chornobyl_Liquidators__Supporter_Pack_Bundle/

notes.title: Long-awaited update is finally here! Enjoy the game with the new VHS mode!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Liquidators![/h1]
Early access to the new patch is over! We’re finally ready to push it fully public! We hope you’ll be enjoying the visual changes to the game and many smaller improvements.

We’ve introduced an additional option in the game settings that allows you to turn the VHS filter onto your game. We’ve tried to capture the soul of ‘80 and make the game more immersive with these on. You can now also adjust the brightness. Take a look for yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35404032/3ed3ccfc17004b66fc0efcd7a6d8b30a3f6946cf.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35404032/b1cc56e9683dd96e2636143ca2d9e35b91d2e303.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35404032/def291072438eccdf619c663bebc8facd6ff9b85.gif[/img]

[h3]But wait, there’s still more![/h3]
We’ve also enabled the [b]level selection[/b] for all players from the [b]beginning of the game[/b]! You no longer need to finish the game to unlock it. You must finish all the maps to see the ending corresponding to your in-game choices. But if, for any reason, you want to skip a map or replay a certain one to see a different ending, you can now do that! 

By the way, we added a tiny extra level -> Not great, not terrible :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35404032/2f467decd3821c7291143809c401aa8079e950ac.png[/img]

We’ve also prepared a special branch for you to jump into if you want to [i]downgrade[/i] a game version for a while in case of some problems or game-breaking glitches. We upgraded to a newer version of the engine, a lot of things have changed, we fixed and tested everything, but we prepared it in case something went wrong.

Here’s the code for the branch -> [spoiler]prevChornobylBuild[/spoiler]

That’s all for today. We hope to see some new faces on our Discord. We look forward to any feedback you may have for us after this new update. As always, thank you for your continued support of our games, and we look forward to hearing from you!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/frozenwayofficial][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35404032/a478f63573f6ff86f22b7ed9d3b78cab48ab465b.png[/img][/url]

Cheers!
~Jacob and Developers

[*] Repaired or improved translations for numerous quests, dialogues, and locations that were previously untranslated.
[*] Corrected color grading in Pripyat.
[*] Restored audio in cutscenes.
[*] Memory optimization implemented, removing many unnecessary elements.

However, as they say, what goes up, must come down. And the reason for our delay is both trivial and positive. It was simply difficult for us to find time to write these few words. There's so much going on here. The project has entered its final phase and work on it is speeding along, like the Soviet Soyuz in Earth's orbit. Chornobyl Liquidators, taking their final shape, began to transform from an ugly duckling into a beautiful and majestic swan. We know how much you count on us, that's why we try to refine every, even the smallest, part of the game down to the smallest detail. notes.title: Chernobyl Liquidators Simulator - Demo Update #3!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35404032/9b622cefd9005f2b5f3328d19a52e850ffd09f1d.png[/img]

[h1]Further changes for our demo are afoot! Make sure to check them below![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35404032/125c587d90d18c9d5ba5efacb832c658e9bd3579.jpg[/img]

As our work continues we are happy to introduce another batch of changes that should make our demo even more enjoyable! Liquidation itself is a hard job and while we want to emulate it as faithfully as possible we definitely profit from your help and reports you send us! 

Check the new changes we've introduced below:

[b]Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*] Full gamepad control support for the main and pause menus
[*] Key bindings guide is now easily available in the pause menu
[*] Tutorial hints in languages other than english now have proper text highlights
[*] Game now starts via included launcher
[*] Fixed issue with interactable objects sometimes being highlighted in full white
[*] Fixed issue with character camera clipping thru vent when player is climbing to crouch stance
[*] Fixed issue with soda machine changing positions as it's light flickers
[*] Multiple smaller fixes and improvements
[/list]

You might notice that starting with this particular patch we're including a new launcher that will let you access the game. This addition should be small and unobtrusive while at the same time giving you a broader look into interesting games created by other companies that we like and respect. We hope that you will have fun using the launcher - in case of any feedback please let us know!

The feedback we received and keep on receiving has been [u]extremely helpful[/u] in identifying the areas of our game that require extra care and nurture. We are happy to say that we've already started working on ensuring that those problems that you reported are taken care of - we want nothing more than to see you all enjoy our game and we'll do our best to make it possible for many players with different PC specifications to enjoy the game. Be on the lookout for the updated PC requirements - we'll post them in future while currently we investigate and collect as much data as possible. 

Thank you for your kind words and suggestions - we've heard a lot from you and we hope to hear even more in future! 

Kind regards,
Chernobyl Liquidators Simulator Team

notes.title: Devlog #40 "UI Update - Part 2 of 2"
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35404032/9b622cefd9005f2b5f3328d19a52e850ffd09f1d.png[/img]

[h1]Welcome to the second part of our UI showcase. This time we'll talk more about the meaning behind those various icons you were able to see last time.[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35404032/fd8239ee4036f3bba562abaa0075ea068bdbe260.png[/img]

To make sure that our players can easily and painlessly enter the world of the game we've decided to prepare some extra info-graphics that will be displayed to you as you play through the game. We will talk more about them in our next devlog - stay tuned for that - but in this one we want to continue our last chat about the icons and UI. Some of the info-graphics will be conveying the most important aspects of the icons in a short and concise way to give you all the information required to survive in the harsh and unforgiving reality of Chernobyl. 

[previewyoutube=1ZfjFmeR_2M;full][/previewyoutube]

We want to make sure that explanation for the particular icons in-game will be short but sweet - just a second needed to look over them to understand what is happening on the screen and to understand their  purpose. Our UI designers are also working really hard to make sure that each of the symbols on your screen is easily recognized - for example red cross with a number under it symbolizes the number of health items available to you while the water tank is... basically a water tank! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35404032/d0f5fa303294c152e44391a3ffb830f71b1db45b.jpg[/img]
[i]Small icons on the right side of the screen (top to bottom): damage resistance, speed up, stamina regeneration, health recovery, health regeneration (over time) and their corresponding negative effects. [/i]

Fire, spillage, radiation - those are the big three of our icons and they will let you know not only what is happening in the area and what kind of danger you are dealing with but also the degree of the threat that you're facing and whether you're still within a safe area.  

The smaller icons that you've seen in the last devlog will be a visual addition to the effects of certain items that you'll be able to use in-game. We hope that their design will help you in getting used to the effects and soon enough, after some time, you'll not have to read the effects but will simply be able to glance at the icons and instinctively know what they do. 

[i]Thank you for checking in this week and see you in the next one![/i]

Kind regards,
Chernobyl Liquidators Simulator Team

notes.title: Devlog #39 "UI Update - Part 1 of 2"
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35404032/9b622cefd9005f2b5f3328d19a52e850ffd09f1d.png[/img]

[h1]We're coming back to the topic of UI - this time let's talk about radial menu and icons.[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35404032/bfc20ed99db4ccfa564f2c0bce3ae882e3e5bcbe.png[/img]

We have discussed the topic of UI previously - at that time we focused on the menus concerning the hints and dialogue boxes. However that is only a part of the grand scheme of things - UI is multilayered as our game is a little bit more complex and featuring tools and collectables system makes it necessary to design a neat UI and menu tailored especially for that particular feature. At the same time we want to make certain areas of the game more clear - to this effect we've been designing specific icons that will be easy and quick to understand.

[previewyoutube=PYKmypqejIU;full][/previewyoutube]

Radial menu that we've prepared is designed to provide you with all the important information about the items and objects that you've collected throughout your gameplay. Not only all of them will receive an icon that will resemble the original object but you will also be able to read a short description of each of the objects and you'll be informed in a concise way about the effects of each of the items. This way you can make snap decision in the heat of a moment but if you have a moment of time and want to read the actual description - that is also completely fine! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35404032/d0f5fa303294c152e44391a3ffb830f71b1db45b.jpg[/img]

We're also happy to present you with the icons that you will see in the game. Some of them you've already seen in the video above, some might be completely new to you. We'll be happy to discuss more about them in our next devlog - up until then we're wondering if you will be able to tell us what they might mean? If you could let us know in the comments what do you think they represent we will appreciate that a lot - it will also be a test of sorts for us to check if they are as transparent as we believe them to be. 

[i]Thank you for checking in this week and see you in the next one![/i]

Kind regards,
Chernobyl Liquidators Simulator Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35404032/9b622cefd9005f2b5f3328d19a52e850ffd09f1d.png[/img]

[h1]Thank you very much for your participation in the playtest - as we continue the testing we are also happy to introduce few fixes and adjustment to the current version of the game![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35404032/d078b307dbca4820560edb96ce021aafea0bacbb.jpg[/img]

[u]Over 30.000 players have participated in the playtest[/u] up until this moment. We are honoured by the reception our tests received and we intend to continue gathering feedback from you as we believe your voice is what truly matters! We are sure that by incoporating your thoughts and ideas within our game we can truly create something unique!

At the current moment we are very happy to introduce a patch to the playtest version of the game based exactly on your feedback. Below you can read what exactly has been changed and improved.

[b]Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*] HELP screens added - available at all the times by pressing F1 or GAMEPAD SELECT buttons
[*] Mouse sensitivity slider is working properly now
[*] Toggle sprint option is working properly no (it is recommended to disable it for GAMEPAD control)
[*] Additional details were added to environment and reactor ruins
[*] Firetrucks are properly scaled now (non-mirrored textures with proper lettering coming soon)
[*] Audio of interactions should now play for a longer time if player died in between them
[*] Timing of audio during the ladder climb cinematic has been properly synchronized with animation
[/list]

We still strongly encourage you to send us as much feedback as you can as it can directly influence the game development and it helps us out a lot. 

Kind regards,
Chernobyl Liquidators Simulator Team
